scope: Independent source review of proposed artifact patches only; no build or native query execution

checks: Public partially-pushed flag and union IU mapping APIs exist on pinned main
Exact source/output annotation checks prevent unadapted optional widening
Predicate whitelist excludes unknown callables, volatile calls, UDFs and row-error arithmetic
Fresh replacement operators preserve canonical Replicate ownership
Separate UnionAll and aggregate doccomments restored
remaining: Semantic row bag and ordered-union checks

reviews.finding: A completed deduplicated-node snapshot does not prove all independent owning slots were rewritten; an old right join could remain reachable through another raw DAG edge.
reviews.repair: Always run a fresh conservative pass after the postorder batch; canonical ownership pays one final no-op traversal while independent aliases receive their missing rewrites.
checks: Snapshot holds owners and current nodes alive
Rules require zero properties plus explicit immutable replacement opt-in
Right join replacement uses no parent metadata, preserves output IDs/types and subplans, creates no new right join candidate
Replicate inputs resolve to shared owner slots
Rule trace and match cap retained

reviews.finding: Direct adjacent window with identical ordered nonempty partition IUs can preserve task partitioning through Map, but the proposed patch ignores the existing shuffle-elimination setting.
reviews.required_repair: Respect OptShuffleElimination with GetDefaultEnableShuffleElimination fallback before selecting Map. Assigned to quality_review.
checks: Immediate predecessor must itself be a Window
Exact ordered partition IU equality implies unchanged key identity and types
No stale inherited C37 metadata is consulted
Map connection uses existing DqCnMap task-preservation contract
remaining: Broader downstream checks when combined with C37
